item.title: DISRUPTION: -1
item.content:encoded:
Personally, the main issue I have here is the fact that it seems like a bunch of ritualistic technobabble thrown together. I get the surreal feeling, but it does not really do anything for me. Phrases like "negative hormones" and "offending complex", and the somewhat weird switching from 3-toothed Leach and Recurrence just made me more confused.

I do like the implied large worldbuilding behind the whole thing though; I'm guessing that it is a twisted form of the Foundation, and the surrealism behind that supports it well. The "Apologies for the inconvenience" made a chill go up my spine.

Downvoting for now due to said main issue.

item.title: SCP-500:
item.content:encoded: I quite like this one, the interesting part is not so much the pills themselves so much as it is the behavior they create. The sheer paranoia of not having enough for something you really need it for results in not using them at all, even if it could solve a lot of problems.

item.title: SCP-5418: -1 :(
item.content:encoded:
Downvoted. Sorry :(

In my opinion, this needs to be looked over once more. There's a lot of glaring SPAG errors as well as poorly phrased sentencing and unclincal tone.

For instance:

Special Containment Procedure Updated

Flows badly: Updated Special Containment Procedures flows better.

introduces itself as Oulen.

Flows badly: I would put the first sentence as two things - "SCP-5418 is a seventeen-year-old male humanoid of Mongolian descent." then "SCP-5418 refers to itself as Oulen".

As of now, It needs a polish and a round of critique before posting imo.

-1

item.title: SCP-239: Anything to prevent GoIs from abduction?
item.content:encoded: Though what about if a GoI attempts to abduct 239. Are there any security protocals to prevent GoI to infiltrate 239's containment cell and abduct her. I'm pretty sure that the Chaos Insurgency, (a GoI that want to use SCPs for their own goals) would be interested in acquiring 239 so that they can do what ever they want. Like, the CI can have her say "the Chaos Insurgency rules all of mankind" and they would have world domination in a instant. Heck, they don't even need to kidnap her, just steal a blood sample of her's and after a bit of cloning, bam, their own god like girl.

item.title: SCP-239:
item.content:encoded: I think the Chaos Incurgency would want 239 more than the Serpant's Hand. CI want to use SCPs to goals, and having a SCP that can create and do anything could benifit them.
